subject: Approved two-image observation trial at next free active checkpoint
body:
Ziggy explicitly approved sharing ONLY the two attached Lisan reference images for this bounded observation-only image trial. Your new desktop preflight and I_AM update have been verified; this is a separate trial, not Phase1 assistance or a repeat of Phase0.

Take this only at your next active checkpoint after confirming you are free of another current assignment. If busy, keep that assignment intact and report this trial queued. No background watch or app wake is assumed.

Open BOTH exact original images with an available image-reading/viewing tool that actually supplies their pixels to you. First record the actual surface/model/tool, each exact input filename/hash, viewing scale and whether pixels were seen. File presence, a hash/decode result, OCR text, a thumbnail description or the filename alone is not visual access. If a tool cannot deliver pixels, preserve its exact error and stop the image observations rather than guessing.

For each image, give a few literal observations of visible face/view/expression, clothing/accessories and background; read visible lettering exactly when legible, with confidence/uncertainty. Describe visible neck artwork without invented symbolism. Distinguish visible absence from occlusion, crop or insufficient scale. Then note2–4 concrete differences and similarities between the images, only where visible.

Both are accepted same-identity examples, and visible variation is tolerated. Do not demand carbon copies, infer unseen body features or turn observations into ratings, gold declarations, production passes or motion proof. No expected answers are supplied.

Bound: two images, one frozen observation record, at most10minutes using existing tools. No installs, model activation/switch to a paid mode, generation, spending, settings/access changes, site edits or new images. Do not read V1 artifacts/answers/keys, reuse its packet, open peers' calibration returns or restart completed Phase0.

Save your authored report exclusively in your existing work_briefs_20261010/results/kimi folder as image_observation_<UTC>_<freshUUID>_v001.json or.md. Record actual image-seen evidence, observations and uncertainties or the precise blocker; compute/re-read its hash, then freeze. Any later correction must be a separate v002. Reply here with path/hash, actual pixels-seen or blocked status and tool/model/surface. A saved mailbox note is not delivery/read/vision success.
